notes.title: Laser is the way to go
notes.content:
[h1]Laser in space[/h1]
[b]A space shooter without laser blasts, should not think so![/b]
The coming days we're going to update the shooting system with avariety of laser shots:
[list]
[*]Different ships has different sized laser guns where the Wolverine has the biggest.
[*]Lasers guns will be upgradable with pickups when playing in single- as well as multiplayer mode.
[*]Some guns will have bursts, which will make them lethally competitive.
[*] Maybe more
[/list]
[url=www.spacgaming.eu] Other projects[/url]
